Plan of activities
Sunday, 01 April 2018
5084 Hits
Date
Activities/Venue
Brief discription of activity
02/04/2018 Monday
• Gram Swachhata abhiyan - Karanji Kaji Village
• Anti-kharra drive rally by school students – Bhidi Village
• Demonstration on hand washing – Dhotra Railway village
Village Health Nutrition Sanitation Committee members along with villagers will conduct Gram swachhata
Anti-tobacco and anti-spitting drive by health care of Rural Hospital Bhidi, staff of Rural Health Training Centre and School children
Hand washing demonstration will be done for members of VHNSC and Women;s Self Help Group
03/04/2018 Tuesday
• Hand Hygiene demonstration Zilla Parishad Uchha Prathamik School Warud Village
• Swachhata rally by School students Kajalsara village
• Workshop on safe water and sanitation – Padegaon village
• Gram swachhata abhiyan – Pavnoor village
Hand hygiene demonstration will be carried by Medical Social Worker at ZP High School of Warud
Rally on swachhata will be taken out by school students along with members of Kiran clinic of Kajalsara
A workshop on Safe water and sanitation will be conducted for Women’s SHG members by the Medical Social Workers and ANM’s of Talegaon Sector
Gram swachhata abhiyan will be conducted by the member of VHNSC and community in village Pavnoor
04/04/2018 Wednesday
• Swachh Ghar – Competition Chitoda Village
• Street play by school students – Stop usage of polythene bags
• Poster Exhibition – Ekurli village
Swachh Ghar competition will be organized and a team will visit each household and judge the swachhata on the basis of criteria
A street play will be conducted in village Wabgaon by school students on stopping usage of polythene bags
A poster exhibition will be displayed in Ekurli village on safe water and sanitation by the staff of Talegaon Sector
05/04/2018 Thursday
• Gram Swachhata abhiyan Nandora Village
• Swachhata Rally Shirpur village
• Gram Swachhata abhiyan Neri Village
Gram Panchayat members along with community will conduct Gram Swachhata Abhiyan
Swachhata rally will be conducted by school children
Gram Panchayat members, VHNSC members along with community will conduct Gram Swachhat Abhiyan in Neri village
06/04/2018 Friday
• Role play on safe water and sanitation - Mandaogad village
• Gram Swachhata abhiyan - Kharda Village
• Street play on sanitation – Selu Kate Village
• Gram Swachhata Abhiyan – Pandharkawda Village
Role play on safe water and sanitation will be conducted by the Adolescent girls during Village Health Nutrition day
Gram Swachhata abhiyan will be conducted by the community of village Kharda
A street play on Sanitation will be conducted in Selu Kate Village by members of Community Based Organization – Kishori Panchayat Girls
Gram swachhata abhiyan will be conducted by gram panchayat members, SHG members and villagers in Pandharkawda village
07/04/2018 Saturday
• Role play on safe water and sanitation and personal hygiene Sub-centre - Madni
• Disposal of e-waste
• Swachhata Rally by Medical students of 2017 batch in village Padegaon
Role play will be conducted on safe water, sanitation and personal hygiene by health care staff and Medical Social Worker
Disposal of e-waste will be done by staff of Rural Health Training Centre, Bhidi.
A swachhata rally will be carried by the Medical students of 2015 batch for creating awareness regarding safe water and sanitation
09/04/2018 Monday
• Cleanliness drive at Rural Health Training Centre, Bhidi
• Swachhata rally – Wadad village
• Health education session on Safe water and sanitation – Middle School of Anji Village
A cleanliness drive will be done at the Rural Health Training Centre, Bhidi by the staff of centre
A swachhata rally will be carried by the community members of Wadad village
Health education session on safe water and sanitation will be conducted for school children of Middle school of Anji village
10/04/2018 Tuesday
• Posture exhibition – Women’s Self Help Group Dhanora village
• Cleaning of Kiran clinic – Anji
• Awareness campaign on Safe water and sanitation – Dhotra Kasar School
A posture exhibition will be arranged by the Medical Sociall Workers and VHNSC members on Swachhata
Cleaning of Kiran clinic and premises by the Kiran clinic committee members of Anji village
School teachers and medical social workers will conduct awareness campaign on swachhata among school children and also took pledge on Swachhata
11/04/2018 Wednesday
• Gram Panchayat and Anganwadi premises – Swachhata Abhiyan Taroda Village
• Essay and Poster competition on Swachhata – Wabgaon School
• Sensitization of Kishori Panchayat members – Safe water and sanitation
Gram Panchayat members and community will conduct swachhata abhiyan in the premises of Gram Panchayat and Anganwadi
An essay and poster competition will be conducted by the staff of RHTC, Bhidi in Wabgaon School on Swachhata Hi Seva
Sensitization of Kishori Panchayat Members on Safe water and sanitation will be done by the staff of Talegaon Sector
12/04/2018 Thursday
• Cleanliness of School premises – Ashram School, Kolhapur Rao
• Hand washing demonstration for Anganwadi children – Jamtha village
Cleanliness drive will be done in the premises of Ashram school of Kolhapur Rao by the staff and students of Ashram school
A hand washing demonstration will be given to the preschool children of Anganwadi by the Anganwadi worker and ASHA
13/04/2018 Friday
• Gram Swachhata Abhiyan Pujai Village
• Mahila Melawa Ratnapur Village
• Gram Swachhata Abhiyan Sonegaon Station Village
Gram Panchayat members and community will conduct swachhata abhiyan in the village
Address on Importance of Swachhata to the Women’s Self Help Groupmembers of Ratnapur by the staff of RHTC, Bhidi
Gram Panchayat members, VHNSC members and Women;s SHG members will conduct swachhata abhiyan in the village
Department of Community Medicine and Premises
Cleanliness of department and premises (Road-side cleanliness)
Disposal of un-used items of the department
Cleaning of gardens
Segregation of dry and wet waste – provision of bins
White Coat Army Activity (1
st
April 2018 – 15
th
April 2018)
Awareness campaign – ant-tobacco campaign by the members of the white coat army of Mahatma Gandhi Institute of Medical Sciences, Sewagram among the relatives visiting Kasturba Hospital, Sewagram.
NSS Volunteer Activity
Tree Plantation by the Medical students of 2017 batch (Facilitation by Garden Section)
Activity by General OPD
Role play by Medical Social Workers of Department of Community Medicine on Safe water and sanitation – Registration OPD area
Poster exhibition on Safe water and sanitation (Kasturba Nursing College, Community Medicine Department)
Activity by GMLF/Urban Health Centre
Sensitization of the patients attending OPD at UHC and Multi-speciality clinic
Swachhata abhiyan on alternate days during the Pakhwada for 0ne hour in the premises
Development of IEC material like pamphlets, posters etc. on Cleanliness
Awareness program in the field practice area of Urban Health Centre
Swachhata Pakhwada April 2024
